itens.trecho: Berlim, o spin-off mais aguardando chegou... A série é boa, mas não podemos negar que é mais da mesma. Berlim nos mostra um lado melancólico, psicopata e apaixonado, nos apresentando um lado que não tinhamos visto em La Casa de Papel.

Decent series with decent pacing. The series is more focused on the love angle and less focused on the heist itself but that's ok. Overall a decent timekiller but don't expect anything extraordinary, the plot armor for the thiefs is not over the top as they have their ups and downs.

I suppose the Spanish love more? So much so that the most brilliant thief ever just does dumber and dumber things. Everyone needs to fuck in this mind numbingly stupid series about some douche. He sucks. Team is fine. Heist is dumb. Aftermath is dumb. Amor!
